title: Towards Selection as Power: Bounding Decision Authority in Autonomous Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the probabilistic concentration of selection authority (i.e., the deviation of a favored candidate's inclusion probability from uniform expectation) using a Selection Risk Index (SRI) under adversarial attacks like variance inflation and threshold bracketing.
Evaluating the asymmetry and diversity of rationales (pro and con arguments) generated by the agent to influence downstream decision-makers, measured via Framing Entropy (FE).

Assessing the agent's ability to manipulate human choice by biasing the temporal presentation ordering of surfaced candidates, measured by the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of ordering manipulation strategies.
